name: Hagino Kana
source: Despite her short stature, Kana is actually a sophomore at Nadeshiko Academy. She is a novelist that focuses mainly on romance stories. To keep her identity hidden, she writes under the pen name of Naka Nogiwa (那珂 野際). She is very interested in the relationships of the other characters in the series so that she can generate ideas for her novels.
